dedupe_keys.name: simulation results of the grid serving multi use of residential battery storage systems for prosumers

description: A German university team deposits simulation results for three uses of residential battery storage by prosumers. Zenodo lists three public ZIPs under CC BY 4.0: self-consumption increase alone, self-consumption combined with peak shaving, and self-consumption combined with ancillary services. These results can benchmark household-storage dispatch or grid-service scenarios against an article-specific use-case set. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this result package. A limitation is that the landing page does not name geography, simulation time resolution, battery capacities, tariffs, electricity profiles or output units. The files represent modelled outcomes, not meter observations or an executable dispatch model. The associated conference paper is named through the DOI relation, but no numerical claim from it was imported into the draft. Reuse requires opening the archives and assessing comparability of scenarios before calibration. No ZIP was downloaded and no energy or revenue result was reproduced.
